title: PRVC at the ceiling: volume not achieved
summary: A passive COPD patient on PRVC at 500 mL with a high-pressure limit of 30. Bronchospasm sets in at 30 s: the regulator raises pressure a step a breath, hits its ceiling five below the limit, and the volume falls short — the ventilator tells you so.
objectives: Read the regulated pressure climbing to the ceiling and the delivered volume falling short; connect the alarm to the resistance.
Fix the cause (bronchodilator) and give the breath more time (Ti 1.3 s).
